coaching.headline: Nobody touched Feng Mao after the Mini Prime fight: 14 kills without a death, while Serath's kills went to Lt. Belica.

flags.text: Feng Mao took 11 of his 15 kills in our half, mostly offlane and mid, and only one was answered; Seedlings and Fangtooths went 0-3.
Shinbi beat Aurora, then died seven times to the same damn jungler, six on the offlane, with Serath on another lane or dead for four.
With Lt. Belica dead, Serath fell first, offlane and duo fought two separate fights, lost 0-5, and two inner towers and Fangtooth fell.
Our kill lead bought only Mini Prime and their offlane outer tower; seven of our kills went into Lt. Belica, who still out-earned Wraith.

focus.title: Answer Feng Mao, fight on one lane
focus.action: When Feng Mao kills on one side, the jungler goes there next instead of mid; when our jungler goes down first, the other four group at one tower instead of fighting on two lanes.

12.6.call: Serath opened by killing Lt. Belica in mid, then crossed to the offlane and killed Feng Mao right after he got Shinbi. The only time all game Feng Mao was answered, and it bought Mini Prime.

25.4.call: Lt. Belica was dead, but Serath fell first to Aurora on the offlane while the duo died on its own lane: two fights at once, lost 0-5. With the jungler gone first, the duo leaves its lane to join the offlane, or everyone backs to the inner towers.

30.1.call: Shinbi died to Feng Mao on the offlane again and Wraith fell in mid seconds later, right after killing Lt. Belica, and Orb Prime went with both solo laners down. Near a Prime the solo laners group before taking another fight.

31.9.call: Feng Mao killed Serath in our own jungle and Wraith fell in mid right after. Down two with no jungler, the mid inner tower and inhibitor fell within the minute; the three left defend the next structure together instead of fighting in mid.

8f8a1346-8011-411c-aa95-f6d7de6b4c86: Four kills on Aurora, none conceded, their offlane outer tower, team-high gold and hero damage; Aurora took both our offlane towers right after deaths to Lt. Belica and Feng Mao.
Seven of eight deaths went to Feng Mao: the first three on the offlane in their half, the rest on our side, two within 45 seconds of scoring a kill.
After any offlane kill with Feng Mao missing from the map, ward the offlane-side river entrance and back off to the tower before taking the next wave.
58cd21d0-6b1f-449b-a598-94cc33d52ec6: Opened strong: four kills on Lt. Belica, and the kill on Feng Mao that answered him in the only fight we won, right before Mini Prime.
Went down first before both late collapses, to Aurora on the offlane and to Feng Mao in our own jungle; three inner towers, Fangtooth and both inhibitors fell behind it.
Died on the offlane twice within a minute of Shinbi dying there, to Feng Mao and then Aurora; bring a second ally before answering the next one.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Ran the vision: 27 wards, the most in the game, and three kills on Lt. Belica without a single death to Lt. Belica.
All eight deaths came on our side of the river: five to Feng Mao, Serath elsewhere for two, and three late to TwinBlast, one right after killing Lt. Belica.
Hold the mid wave inside our ward coverage; when Feng Mao or TwinBlast leaves vision, step back toward the tower before lining up Knock, Knock!
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Farm held at 9.5 CS per minute and only two deaths, both inside the two late collapses: to Gadget on the duo lane, then Aurora in mid.
Both our duo towers fell before we took theirs: the outer to Gadget within a minute of a Wraith death, the inner after all five of us died.
A rotation kill on TwinBlast in mid came 9 seconds after a Wraith death there. When the duo wave is pushed and Gadget shows elsewhere, hit the duo tower.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Most damage mitigated in the game at 45865, plus 6899 healing and zero deaths before minute ten.
Seven wards to Gadget's 21 and none cleared; two of three deaths came inside the late collapses, both to TwinBlast.
Before each Fangtooth, place the third ward Sanctification allows on the pit approaches; the enemy took all three Fangtooths.

matchup: Aurora was the lane opponent: four Shinbi kills on Aurora, no deaths to Aurora, and 17617 gold to 16452.
Feng Mao was the real offlane threat, with seven kills on Shinbi and the most healing in the game.
build: Five completed items and zero physical armor, against Feng Mao's physical damage.
Tainted Scepter and Oathkeeper, two of the winning core, were not built.
Magnify cuts magical armor 6% per ability hit on heroes, stacking five times, and adds omnivamp.
eternal: Aion turns 6% of spell damage on enemy heroes into gold; Philosopher generates gold every 10s.
Philosopher with Arcane Resonance is Aion's best pair.
Pilow holds the best odds in a field toss-up with Aion and Vesh on Shinbi offlane.
augment: Allegro lowers Rushing Beat's cooldown by 15%, the most played Shinbi offlane augment.
Crescendo leans ahead in the field: bonus magical damage on the chain's final basic attack, giving up the faster dash.
crest: Obelisk's Condemn is an empowered basic attack; a target dying within 3s yields a Soul, and Souls add damage and magical power.
Obelisk holds the best odds in a toss-up with Soulbearer. Sound keep.
improvement: If Feng Mao keeps killing on the offlane, a physical armor item for Magnify buys survival, giving up the magical armor shred.
Tainted Scepter, from the winning core, cuts healing 45% on magical damage against Feng Mao's game-high healing.

matchup: Feng Mao was the jungle opponent: two kills on Serath, one death to Serath, and 21623 gold to 13540.
Feng Mao's Reaping Dash hits for a share of current health, and his Earth Shatter executes heroes below a health threshold.
Lt. Belica paid early: four Serath kills, all before the enemy's first tower.
build: Sky Splitter, Storm Breaker and Spectra are the full winning core, all three finished.
Draconum adds 40 physical armor against Feng Mao's physical damage, and Flow restores health on takedowns.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles when Serath damages a hero below 30% health.
Dryad's Boon cuts basic cooldowns on basic attacks; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after a dash, leap or teleport like Heaven's Fury.
Weald is clearly the field's best Serath jungle Eternal, with Dryad's Boon and Wind-Rider the best pair. Sound keep.
augment: Crushing Descent makes Ascend stun for 0.2s on damage, and leans ahead of Vital Resonance in the field. Sound keep.
crest: Pacifier dashes and empowers the next physical hit, 2.5x against targets below 20% max health.
Liberator leans ahead of Pacifier in the field: a cleanse of all debuffs and a shield, giving up the dash.
improvement: Keep Draconum's armor: Feng Mao tops hero damage, deals physical damage, and killed Serath twice.
Liberator is the swap to test against Aurora's root and stun, giving up Pacifier's low-health burst.

matchup: Lt. Belica was the mid opponent: three Wraith kills on Belica, no deaths to Belica, yet Belica out-earned Wraith 15615 to 13659.
Neural Disruptor silences and Seismic Assault stuns, the mid lane lockdown.
build: The winning core is Soulbinder, Noxia and Wraith Leggings; zero were built, and all four completed items are physical power items.
Tainted Trident cuts healing 45% on physical damage, against Feng Mao's game-high 19717 healing.
Vanquisher executes heroes taken below 5% health; Mutilator adds max-health damage on basic attacks and ability hits.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles on damaging a hero below 30% health; Forage adds gold and experience per minion or monster kill.
Lotus leans ahead in the field on Wraith mid; Weald trails, with Forage and Wind-Rider as Weald's best pair.
augment: Sniper's Bounty adds gold on Knock, Knock! killing blows, 40 on heroes; clearly the field's best Wraith mid augment. Sound keep.
crest: Ortus grants 20% movement speed and 10% physical power for 7s; takedowns inside the window add permanent power.
Witchstalker holds the best odds in a toss-up with Liberator; both cleanse all debuffs, and Ortus trails both.
improvement: No completed item carries armor or health; a defensive item for Mutilator is the swap to test against Feng Mao.

matchup: Duo was Drongo and Steel against TwinBlast and Gadget; zero duo deaths on either side before minute ten.
Gadget's Security Gate roots and Tesla Dome shreds magical armor; TwinBlast's Vortex Grenade slows.
Drongo's two deaths went to Gadget on the duo lane and Aurora in mid; TwinBlast never killed Drongo.
build: Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher and Tainted Rounds are the full winning core, all three finished.
Nuclear Rounds raises ability damage 10-20% by critical chance, feeding Gag Grenade, Rad Rounds and Shrapnel Cannon.
Tainted Rounds cuts healing 45% on basic attacks, against Feng Mao's game-high healing.
eternal: Xyris adds 3% bonus damage, growing with units killed; Bone Collector adds 20% critical chance after 150 unit kills.
Xyris sits in a field toss-up with Weald and Marrow on Drongo carry; Iron Will with Bone Collector edges Furor's pair.
augment: Bring The Boom makes Rad Rounds deal 60% of the damage to nearby enemies on exploding.
Shred Spree leans ahead in the field: a far shorter Shrapnel Cannon cooldown for less damage, giving up the splash.
crest: Pacifier dashes and empowers the next physical hit, stronger below 20% max health.
Pacifier shares a field toss-up with Liberator and Eviscerator. Sound keep.
improvement: Test Shred Spree next game: Shrapnel Cannon's physical armor shred comes far more often, at half the damage.
Full winning core finished; no item change is proven by this game, so the build stays.

matchup: Duo was Steel and Drongo against Gadget and TwinBlast; Gadget placed 21 wards to Steel's seven.
Steel killed Gadget once; Steel's three deaths went twice to TwinBlast and once to Feng Mao.
Enemy lockdown: Gadget's Security Gate root, Lt. Belica's Seismic Assault stun, Aurora's Hoarfrost root and Cryoseism stun.
build: Xenia, Dynamo and Gaia Greaves are the full winning core, all three finished.
Xenia shields an ally hero within 200 units; Dynamo makes immobilized enemies take 8% more damage.
Flux Matrix makes nearby enemy heroes take 10% more magical damage, feeding Shinbi's magical damage.
eternal: Krix adds maximum health growing with level; Regenerative Tissue regenerates after 8s without hero damage, Cannibalism adds 25 health per takedown.
Knell leans ahead of Krix in the Steel support field; Krix is the most played.
augment: Heavy Metal adds magical damage to Heavy Punches and Shield Bash equal to 10% of total armor.
Colossal Crash holds the best odds in a toss-up with Heavy Metal: Shield Slam knocks back instead, giving up the armor damage.
crest: Sanctification shields Steel and nearby heroes, adds tenacity while the shield holds, and raises the ward cap to three.
Leafsong leans ahead of Sanctification in the field: a team speed burst instead of the shield, and both keep the third ward.
improvement: Items and Heavy Metal hold; Knell over Krix and Leafsong over Sanctification only lean, so any swap is a test.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.5s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
ourKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
ourKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

ourKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
ourKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
ourKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
ourKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

ourKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
ourKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
ourKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
ourKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
enemyKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
enemyKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
enemyKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

enemyKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
enemyKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
enemyKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down
